Paragraph: Casting off his monkey semblance, the son of the Wind-god Hanuma attained the persona of an ascetic, for that monkey is incredulous in mind about the Raghavas.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Hanuman is cautious and suspicious about the true identity and intentions of the two strangers, fearing they may be enemies sent by Vali.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Hanuman disguises himself prudently as an ascetic before approaching, exercising caution rather than impulsive trust.
Outcome/Resolution: Hanuman proceeds toward Rama and Lakshmana in a safer, non-threatening guise.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Anxiety: Wariness, suspicion, apprehension about the unknown

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Hanuman exercises viveka, discerning wisdom, choosing a prudent approach rather than a reckless one.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Shows adaptive anxiety management - assessing risk and modifying behavior (disguise) to reduce perceived threat before engaging strangers.
